issue.title: Re-measure the SASE_TEST_SELECTION_DEPTH table before recommending depth 3
issue.description: The static-selection implementation reproduces the epic plan's median-selection-rate table at depths 0-2, but its depth-3 median measures 9.9%, not the plan's assumed 5.5% -- depth 3 is ~2.4x more expensive than the plan believes. The epic plan's own remediation advice for a nonzero false-negative rate is to raise SASE_TEST_SELECTION_DEPTH to 3, so that advice should not be followed without re-measuring against real usage first. Proposed by epic sase-fp's land phase (sase-fp.8.3), originally measured during sase-fp.1 (Static import-graph selection engine).
